covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: 362 English National Rail stations left without a home by UK station fill phase 2a's fifteen named regions and the 15 Sep 2026 reassignment, from the UK's national real-time feed.

stations: 362 stations: every Darwin-verified English National Rail station with no home region, after UK station fill phase 2a (14 Sep 2026 UK station fill, phase 2b) and the 74-station reassignment out to real regions' administrative territory (15 Sep 2026, docs/jim-brief-rest-of-england-reassignment.md, docs/uk-station-fill/assignment.md).
notes: This is an internal catch-all region, not a place a rider picks by name — the country-wide station picker searches across every region including this one.
